_note: Round-1 pilot (2026-07-10): non-caster active abilities, Conqueror only — DRAFT for Game Owner review. Schema mirrors spells where possible. kind: active (used on your turn) | reaction (used off-turn; server spends costs, rules text resolves at the table) | attack-enhancer (declared on an attack) | passive (choice-gated passive, no use-ability). resolution: auto (server rolls/applies) | manual (server validates + spends costs + prints the rule with computed numbers). targetEffect stacks are computed server-side but applied at the table until the encounter model lands. Sources: C&S PDF pp.35-41; energy max comes from the class TABLE (10→120, N8: tables beat prose — the '150 Energy' line is superseded). Open questions A1-A6 in OPEN-QUESTIONS.md. Round-2 (2026-07-12): Barbarian added — sources C&S PDF pp.27-32. Rage X (AC bonus) / Y (damage bonus) scaling lives in class-abilities.json rageScaling. Schema extensions introduced for Barbarian: costs[].amountDice {count,sides} (dice-based fury costs, total = amount + roll), usesPerRage (once-per-rage abilities, reset by Killing Spree), healing.dice {countBase,countPerLevelBeyond,sides}, targetEffect.stacks {levelOffset} and {levelMultiplier} (formulas floor((level+offset)/N) and floor(level*M/N)). Barbarian open questions B1-B14 in OPEN-QUESTIONS.md. RULINGS 2026-07-13: duplicate-list question (a) — newest NAMED lists win: old conqueror draft majors and the barbarian rage-upgrade-medium group removed; rest ruling (b) — any rest restores ceil(tier% × max) uses/stacks ('on-rest' policy = tier-scaled).

barbarian.name: Fury Pool
barbarian.description: Only active while raging. Whenever you deal damage while raging, roll 1d6 and add it to the pool (AoE damage from one attack still rolls only once) — the player adjusts the pool manually. The pool starts at 0 when you enter a rage and resets to 0 when the rage ends. DISASTER RULE: if the pool ever drops below 0 or exceeds 10, your rage immediately ends and you take 2d10 true damage per barbarian level. An ability that would drop the pool below 0 fails, but the fury cost is still paid (and the pool can drop below 0 as a result).
barbarian._question: B12 — fury costs with dice (1d4 / 2+1d4 / 4+1d4) are modeled as costs[].amount + costs[].amountDice; confirm the server rolls the d4 at spend time (a bad roll can push the pool below 0 and trigger the disaster rule)

abilities.name: Adrenaline
abilities.description: You gain 3 AP immediately, but start your next turn with 3 fewer AP. Usable WILL-modifier times per rest (minimum 1), at most once per turn.

abilities.name: Indomitable Perseverance
abilities.description: Spend 1 perseverance stack and 1 AP to regain [(your level)d10 + (your level) × CON modifier] HP. From level 10 (Endurance), spending a stack also regains 20 energy.

abilities.name: Combat Style: Destruction
abilities.description: Crit range improves by 1 (crit at 19+ if you critted at 20, etc.); your 6 AP two-handed attack doubles ALL damage, not just dice and modifier.

abilities.name: Combat Style: Evasive
abilities.description: +2 AC.

abilities.name: Combat Style: Agile
abilities.description: When dual wielding, your off-hand weapon adds your full stat modifier to damage instead of the usual penalty.

abilities.name: Combat Style: Duelist
abilities.description: When wielding a weapon in one hand and nothing or a shield in the other, add [your level] extra damage of the weapon's type.

abilities.name: Combat Style: Precision
abilities.description: No long-range disadvantage with Throw weapons; hits may force a CON save (DC 8 + 2 × proficiency) or be pushed back 5 ft.

abilities.name: Combat Style: Obstruction
abilities.description: On hitting an enemy, you can apply [your level / 2] (rounded up) taunted stacks.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description: Against a melee weapon attack: DEX save + proficiency vs the attack roll. On ≥, you take no damage and the attacker loses twice the attack's AP cost. Melee weapon attacks only.

abilities.name: Block
abilities.description: Until the triggering attack resolves, your PA and MA are tripled. Applies to melee and ranged, weapon and spell.

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.description: After the triggering melee attack resolves, immediately use the Attack action against the attacker. Melee attacks only.

abilities.name: Dodge
abilities.description: Impose disadvantage on the triggering attack: the attacker must roll again and succeed twice for the attack to take effect.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.description: Your attack attempts to hit all enemies within your weapon's reach; resolve attack and damage separately per target. Melee weapons only.

abilities.name: Crippling Strike
abilities.description: The attack applies rooted stacks equal to [your level / 3], rounded up.

abilities.name: Cull the Meek
abilities.description: On a hit, apply Wounded with value [your weapon's average damage / 3] (rounded down) for 3 rounds.

abilities.name: Breaching Blow
abilities.description: The attack applies exposed stacks equal to [your level / 2], rounded up.

abilities.name: Deflect
abilities.description: Nullify a projectile-based ranged attack against you; DEX save (vs spell DC, or 8 + attack modifier) to redirect it back at the attacker. In a projectile AoE: nullify on yourself freely; within 5 ft of center, a successful deflection negates the spell for everyone and re-centers it on the caster.

abilities.name: Volatile Shell
abilities.description: When hit: resistance to all damage types of that attack for that instance; afterwards, immunity to the attack's base category (physical or magical) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Barrier
abilities.description: Negate an ability's entire effect on yourself. You cannot use Barrier against that same ability again this combat.

abilities.name: Ruthless Barrage
abilities.description: After a weapon attack hits: make up to 4 additional standard weapon attacks against the same target; the sequence ends on the first miss.

abilities.name: Master Strike
abilities.description: Applied to a hit: the target gains disarmed stacks equal to [your level].

abilities.name: Battering Ram
abilities.description: Dash up to 30 ft in a straight line; separate attack roll against each creature you pass through. Hit or miss, each gains prone stacks equal to [your level]. No reactions provoked.

abilities.name: Unfaltering Resolve
abilities.description: You gain death resist for 3 rounds. Used during your turn for 0 AP.

abilities.name: Impervious
abilities.description: For 2 rounds you cannot gain negative effect stacks or new negative effects. Used during your turn for 0 AP.

abilities.name: Thrive on Pain
abilities.description: Reaction when you would take damage: until the start of your next turn, all damage you receive heals you instead, including the triggering damage.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Power
abilities.description: Applied to an attack that hits: the target gains stunned stacks equal to your level.

abilities.name: Overpower
abilities.description: Mark a target within 60 ft (0 AP). For the next 3 rounds, your attacks against it deal true damage and double damage.

abilities.name: Steel Hurricane
abilities.description: Strike all enemies within 30 ft, closest outward — all automatically hit. First target takes your weapon's damage; each subsequent target takes one additional instance (2x, 3x, …), same damage type. Costs 0 AP.

abilities.name: Rage
abilities._question: B2 — text never says 'expend a rage use'; 1 rage assumed. Rage lasts '3 turns' and is extended by Killing Spree
abilities.description: On your turn, enter a rage for 3 turns (0 AP). While raging: advantage on STR saving throws and STR-based Lifting checks, resistance to physical damage, your Natural Defense armor is increased by X, and your STR-based weapon attacks deal +Y additional damage (X and Y from the class table rageScaling). If dual wielding, the bonus damage is halved (rounded up).

abilities.name: Killing Spree
abilities._question: B2 — assumed the automatic rage/extension does NOT consume a rage use
abilities.description: Whenever you kill a target, you automatically enter a rage or, if already raging, extend the rage's duration. This also resets the Raging Attacks you have used.

abilities.name: Rampart
abilities._question: B8 — does the PA bonus track half of the scaled MA bonus, or stay fixed at 1 (half of the base 2)?
abilities.description: While raging (costs 1d4 fury): until the start of your next turn you gain 2 MA and half as much PA (rounded up). The MA bonus increases by 3 for each barbarian level beyond 2 (MA = 2 + 3 x (level - 2)).

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: While raging (costs 2 + 1d4 fury): your next attack strikes all enemies within a 5 ft cone, affecting up to three adjacent squares based on positioning. Roll a separate attack roll and damage roll for each target. Only the first target hit by this attack can generate Fury.

abilities.name: Debilitating Force
abilities.description: While raging (costs 4 + 1d4 fury): apply to an attack that hits. The target gains prone stacks equal to [your barbarian level] (1 base + 1 per level beyond 1).

abilities.name: Obliterate
abilities.description: While raging (costs 10 fury): empower your next attack, causing it to automatically hit, automatically critically hit, and ignore resistance to its damage type. Standard weapon attacks only, not modified versions (such as the 6 AP attack of a two-handed weapon).

abilities.name: Acidic Wrath
abilities.description: While raging (costs 1d4 fury): apply to an attack that hits. The target gains Corroded stacks equal to [(your level - 1) / 2], rounded down (3 at level 8, +1 at level 9 and every 2 levels thereafter).

abilities.name: Savage Restoration
abilities.description: While raging (costs 2 + 1d4 fury): you heal for 6d8, increased by 1d8 for each level you gain after 8th (total dice = level - 2).

abilities.name: Anguished Devastation
abilities.description: While raging (costs 4 + 1d4 fury): apply to an attack that hits but is not a critical strike. The attack's dice damage is doubled. If you are Injured, the entire attack's damage is doubled instead. If you are Severely Injured, the entire attack's damage is tripled instead.

abilities.name: Concuss
abilities.description: While raging (costs 10 fury): apply to an attack that hits. The target gains Stunned stacks equal to two-thirds of your level, rounded down.

abilities.name: Savage Accuracy
abilities.description: Frenzy Instinct (minor) — chosen when you enter a rage, applies only for that rage (one minor, one medium, one major per rage, if unlocked). While raging, you add your rage damage bonus (Y from the class table) to your weapon attack rolls.

abilities.name: Hardened Rage
abilities.description: Frenzy Instinct (minor) — chosen when you enter a rage, applies only for that rage. While raging, the AC bonus granted by your rage (X) is doubled.

abilities.name: Provoking Presence
abilities.description: Frenzy Instinct (minor) — chosen when you enter a rage, applies only for that rage. At the end of each of your turns while raging, you apply taunted stacks to all enemies within 10 ft. Stacks applied = [Y x X / 2], rounded down — the 'Frenzy - Stacks' column of the class table.

abilities.name: Mutilating Wrath
abilities.description: Frenzy Instinct (minor) — chosen when you enter a rage, applies only for that rage. While raging, your weapon attacks apply maimed stacks on hit. Stacks applied = [Y x X / 2], rounded down — the 'Frenzy - Stacks' column of the class table.

abilities.name: Hot-Headed
abilities._question: B4 — unlock level for Frenzy Instincts (Medium) is missing from the class table; defaulted to 8
abilities.description: Frenzy Instinct (medium) — chosen when you enter a rage, applies only for that rage. While raging, you increase your critical strike chance by X, where X is the AC bonus granted by your rage.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.description: Frenzy Instinct (medium) — chosen when you enter a rage, applies only for that rage. While raging, you gain [5 x Y]% lifesteal, where Y is the damage bonus from your rage: you heal for that percentage of the attack damage you deal.

abilities.name: Bloodlust (Alternative)
abilities._question: B4, B11 — are both Bloodlust versions selectable, or is this a table-policy replacement? Text recommends the original for balance
abilities.description: Frenzy Instinct (medium) — easier-to-calculate variant of Bloodlust. While raging, whenever you damage a creature with a weapon attack, you heal for [X x Y / 2]d4 (rounded up) — the number of d4 equals the 'Frenzy - Stacks' class-table column.

abilities.name: Relentless Fury
abilities.description: Frenzy Instinct (medium) — chosen when you enter a rage, applies only for that rage. While raging, you gain a bonus to all saving throws equal to X, where X is the AC bonus granted by your rage.

abilities.name: Vault of Ire
abilities.description: Frenzy Instinct (medium) — chosen when you enter a rage, applies only for that rage. While raging, before making a weapon attack you may leap up to [2 x your level] ft toward the target; the leap does not provoke attacks of opportunity and ignores surfaces and traps along the jump (except at the landing point). Once per turn while raging, you may also perform such a leap without making an attack for 1 AP.

abilities.name: Rage Upgrade: Taunting Blows
abilities._question: B6 — options are unnamed in the source; names invented for display
abilities.description: Rage upgrade (major) — chosen when you enter a rage, applies only for that rage. Your attacks force the target to make a WIS saving throw against DC [8 + 2 x your proficiency]; on a fail they are taunted by you — they cannot move away and can only have you as their main target (spells included).

abilities.name: Rage Upgrade: Swift Attacks
abilities.description: Rage upgrade (major) — chosen when you enter a rage, applies only for that rage. Your standard weapon attacks cost 1 less AP (attacking with both weapons if light).

abilities.name: Rage Upgrade: Defy Death
abilities._question: B10 — what is 'your killer's might' in the DC, and clarify '(loses the effect after burning, poison, etc.)'
abilities.description: Rage upgrade (major) — chosen when you enter a rage, applies only for that rage. If you would take lethal damage, make a CON saving throw against DC [your killer's might + 8]. On a success, return to life with 1 HP and become immune to damage until the start of your next turn (loses the effect after burning, poison, etc.). When the rage ends you fall unconscious.

abilities.name: Ravaging Fury
abilities._question: B14 — assumed this consumes 1 rage use (it activates your rage)
abilities.description: Reaction when someone attacks you: activate your rage. If the attack is a melee one, the attacker must make a CON saving throw against DC [8 + your proficiency + your STR modifier]; on a fail they are knocked prone and the attack fails.

abilities.name: Leaping Smash
abilities._question: B3 — Raging Attacks (1) unlock level is missing from the class table; defaulted to 4
abilities.description: Raging Attack (once per rage, resets on Killing Spree, 0 AP): as part of an attack you jump up to 15 ft to the target. The attack has a 4-dice-value / 20% increased crit chance (crits on 16+ if you previously crit at 20) and does not trigger attacks of opportunity. If you move at least 2 AP worth of movement in a straight line beforehand, the range increases to up to 45 ft.

abilities.name: Cleaving Slashes
abilities.description: Raging Attack (once per rage, resets on Killing Spree, 0 AP): for the rest of the turn your attacks are horizontal slashes that attack all targets in a 180-degree cone in front of you. Requires a two-handed strength-based weapon.

abilities.name: Crippling Blow
abilities.description: Raging Attack (once per rage, resets on Killing Spree, 0 AP): activate on an attack, before or after rolling the attack roll. The target must succeed on a CON saving throw against DC [8 + your proficiency + your STR modifier] or be rooted for 1 round.

abilities.name: Earthquake Smash
abilities._question: B9 — DEX save DC unspecified; assumed [8 + proficiency + STR mod]
abilities.description: Raging Attack (once per rage, resets on Killing Spree, 3 AP): you leap to a point exactly 60 ft away and hit the ground with your weapon. Roll your weapon damage and double the dice damage. All targets within 15 ft must make a DEX saving throw, taking force damage equal to the rolled amount on a fail or half as much on a success.

abilities.name: Vampiris Slashes
abilities._question: B13 — 'vampiris' spelling kept from the source (likely 'Vampiric')
abilities.description: Raging Attack (once per rage, resets on Killing Spree, 0 AP): for the rest of your turn, your attacks heal you for half the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Power Blow
abilities._question: B9 — CON save DC unspecified; assumed [8 + proficiency + STR mod] like Crippling Blow
abilities.description: Raging Attack (once per rage, resets on Killing Spree, 0 AP): activate on an attack, before or after rolling the attack roll. The target must make a CON saving throw or be knocked prone.

abilities.name: Ultimate Rage (Unstoppable)
abilities.description: When raging, you can choose as many upgrades (Frenzy Instincts / rage upgrades) as you want, no longer limited to one per tier.
